name: John Munroe
role: Partner in Shaffer & Munroe, Plum Grove ranch
bio: John Munroe was a partner with Chas. Shaffer in Shaffer & Munroe, of the Plum Grove ranch on the Little Missouri. The partnership dissolved on May 24, 1884, and Munroe took on its debts.
